about: Log 414 held-out set, written 2026-10-12 before any run of it. Gold follows scripts/capability_sheet.yaml and each workflow's documented reading and inputs. UN: a requirement of no typed kind, in its own sentence, that the workflow for the ask cannot meet; UP: the same kind of requirement, met; HP: a harmless one (format, which samples, where it runs, names); K: the same as a follow-up turn (KN not met, KP met; --resume); XP, XN: plain controls.
